creator API still returns rows with hasMore/nextCursor

honestLimits: The cursor is opaque but not signed; a caller who edits it can only page their own rows, and malformed tokens fall back to the first page.
The cutover dropped the previous overloads, so a rollback to the offset deployment would need the old functions restored first.
One page is still 50 rows; there is no jump-to-end.
